            @keyframes preloader-loading {
                0%,

                    transform: translate(-34px, 0);

                50% {
                    transform: translate(96px, 0);
                }
            }

            .preload-animation {
                width: 200px;
                margin: 0 auto;
                transform: scale(1);
                transition: transform 0.5s ease;
            }

            .preload-animation .preload-image {
                background-image: url(/assets/images/logo-symbol.png);
                height: 52px;
                width: 52px;
                margin: 0 auto 32px;
                transform: translate(0, 0);
                opacity: 1;
                transition: all 0.5s ease-out;
                background-size: 52px 52px;
                background-position: center;
            }

            .preload-animation .loading-bar {
                width: 130px;
                height: 2px;
                margin: 0 auto;
                border-radius: 2px;
                background-color: #cfcfcf;
                position: relative;
                overflow: hidden;
                z-index: 1;
                transform: rotateY(0);
                transition: transform 0.3s ease-in;
            }

            .preload-animation .loading-bar .blue-bar {
                height: 100%;
                width: 68px;
                position: absolute;
                transform: translate(-34px, 0);
                background-color: #15406a;
                border-radius: 2px;
                animation: preloader-loading 1.5s infinite ease;
            }

            .preload-animation .fade-load .preload-image {
                transform: translate(0, 10px);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            .preload-animation .fade-load .loading-bar {
                transform: rotateY(90deg);
            }
        </style>

        <style>
            *,
            *:before,
            *:after {
                box-sizing: border-box;
            }

            .preloader-wrapper {
                margin: 0;
                padding: 0;
                background: #f5f5f5;
                width: 100%;
                height: 100%;
                position: fixed;
                top: 0;
                left: 0;
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                flex-direction: column;
            }

            @keyframes preloader-loading {
                0%,
                100% {
                    transform: translate(-34px, 0);
                }
                50% {
                    transform: translate(96px, 0);
                }
            }

            .preload-animation {
                width: 200px;
                margin: 0 auto;
                transform: scale(1);
                transition: transform 0.5s ease;
            }

            .preload-animation .preload-image {
                background-image: url(/assets/images/logo-symbol.png);
                height: 52px;
                width: 52px;
                margin: 0 auto 32px;
                transform: translate(0, 0);
                opacity: 1;
                transition: all 0.5s ease-out;
                background-size: 52px 52px;
                background-position: center;
            }

            .preload-animation .loading-bar {
                width: 130px;
                height: 2px;
                margin: 0 auto;
                border-radius: 2px;
                background-color: #cfcfcf;
                position: relative;
                overflow: hidden;
                z-index: 1;
                transform: rotateY(0);
                transition: transform 0.3s ease-in;
            }

            .preload-animation .loading-bar .blue-bar {
                height: 100%;
                width: 68px;
                position: absolute;
                transform: translate(-34px, 0);
                background-color: #15406a;
                border-radius: 2px;
                animation: preloader-loading 1.5s infinite ease;
            }

            .preload-animation .fade-load .preload-image {
                transform: translate(0, 10px);
                opacity: 0;
            }

            .preload-animation .fade-load .loading-bar {
                transform: rotateY(90deg);
            }
        </style>
